verdict.rationale: Mintlify serves its own llms.txt, which a probe confirmed live with HTTP 200. Its docs also expose an llms.txt index, and it documents auto-generated llms.txt/llms-full.txt, Markdown versions of pages via a .md suffix, and agent-oriented skill.md files, so an agent can be pointed at agent-ready docs directly. The docs.md probe 404 does not contradict per-page .md export. Missing for 10: independent community or hands-on corroboration of agents consuming llms-full.txt and skill.md in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://www.mintlify.com/llms.txt # Mintlify
